# List

`content/list` &middot; content-level &middot; category: content

## Purpose

A bulleted list with plain or glyph markers (check, dash, arrow).

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | listItems |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Standard bullets.
- **checklist**: Accent-colored check marks. Sets `marker: check`.
- **dashed**: Dash markers. Sets `marker: dash`.
- **plain**: No markers, just spaced lines. Sets `marker: none`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `marker` | one of `disc`, `circle`, `square`, `none`, `check`, `dash`, `arrow` | `"disc"` |
| `level` | one of `body`, `bodyLarge`, `bodySmall` | `"body"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `markerColor` | color | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `itemGap` | length | `"@spacing.sm"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"0 0 @spacing.md 0"` |
| `darkMode` | boolean | `true` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ul and li honored with explicit styles. Glyph markers are table cells. | Fine. | Text swaps via dm-text where honored. Marker glyphs keep the accent color. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('content/list', {
  "items": [
    "Free shipping on orders over $75",
    "Free returns within 60 days",
    "Organic cotton and European linen",
    "Repaired for life at any of our stores"
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "content/list",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      "Free shipping on orders over $75",
      "Free returns within 60 days",
      "Organic cotton and European linen",
      "Repaired for life at any of our stores"
    ]
  }
}
```
